verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud documents a REST API (OpenAPI 3.0) that manages agents, including a POST /agents "Create an Agent" endpoint and starting agent sessions. Its official CLI can deploy to Pipecat Cloud, so the agent-creation step can be done programmatically. Telephony, however, depends on an external carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, etc.) calling your webhook, and nothing shows Pipecat itself attaching a phone number or placing an outbound call via API, CLI, or MCP. missing for 10: first-party phone-number provisioning/attachment via API/CLI, programmatic outbound call placement, an end-to-end provisioning walkthrough, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: The private API (/v1...) manages agents, secrets, builds, regions, and organization settings.
